The '''Galfridian family''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] family who ruled [[Artorias]] when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The family was scattered during the invasion. One of the two [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children of King Caled, Finn, became a member of the [[New Jedi Order]].
